run_3d_body_estimation: run the SAM3DBodyEstimator to estimate 3D body pose, keypoints, and mesh from a single input image
run_full_body_inference: run full-body inference with both body and hand decoders using process_one_image with inference_type set to full
run_body_only_inference: run body-only inference using process_one_image with inference_type set to body to skip hand decoder
run_hand_only_inference: run hand-only inference using process_one_image with inference_type set to hand for hand pose estimation
run_mask_conditioned_inference: run mask-conditioned inference by providing pre-computed masks and bboxes to process_one_image with use_mask enabled
